# Riverside Chess Club: questions

## When do you meet?

Every Thursday from 7pm to 10pm in the back room of the community centre.

## Do I need to bring a board?

No. The club has twelve sets and clocks.

## How much does it cost?

£3 a night, or £30 for the whole year.

## Can children join?

Yes, from age 8, with an adult for the first visit.
